questions.question:
Find out the two signs to be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43
questions.solution:
1) – and ÷

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 + 16 × 14 ÷ 7 – 3

= 14 + 32 – 3

= 46 – 3

= 43 = R.H.S

2) × and ÷

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 + 16 ÷ 14 − 7 × 3

= 14 + 1.14 – 21

= 15.14 – 21

= -5.86 ≠ R.H.S

3) + and –

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 - 16 × 14 + 7 ÷ 3

= 14 – 224 + 2.33

= 16.33 – 224

= - 207.67 ≠ R.H.S

4) – and ×

Given expression: 14 + 16 × 14 − 7 ÷ 3 = 43

After interchanging the symbols, we get:

L.H.S = 14 + 16 - 14 × 7 ÷ 3

= 14 + 16 – 32.66

= 30 – 32.66

= -2.66 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘– and ÷’ is the correct answer

questions.question: In a democracy, the ruling party is accountable to ________

• Article 74 and Article 75 deal with the parliamentary system at the centre and Articles 163 and 164 deals with the states.

• The head of the state holds a ceremonial position and is the nominal executive. For example, the President.
 
• In India, the head of government is the Prime Minister who is the real executive.
